data.name: FwAvalonia.EntryTypeUnsupported
data.value: This entry type is not yet supported in the new view.

data.name: FwAvalonia.UnsupportedEditor
data.value: This field is not yet supported in the new view.

data.name: FwAvalonia.EmbeddedObjectReadOnly
data.value: This text contains formatting the new view cannot edit safely yet.
data.comment: Tooltip on a field the new view shows read-only, because its text has formatting (such as superscript or a color) or an embedded item (such as a picture or footnote) that the new view can't edit safely yet. The text can still be edited in the classic view.

data.name: FwAvalonia.UndoChangeToFormat
data.comment: Undo command label after the user changes one field. {0} = the field's label, e.g. "Undo change to Gloss".

data.name: FwAvalonia.RedoChangeToFormat
data.comment: Redo command label after the user undoes a change to one field. {0} = the field's label, e.g. "Redo change to Gloss".

data.name: FwAvalonia.PossibilityNameOrAbbreviationRequired
data.value: A name or abbreviation is required.
data.comment: Error shown when the user leaves both the Name and the Abbreviation of a list item empty.

data.name: FwAvalonia.EditDiscardedInvalid
data.value: Your edit was discarded because it is invalid: {0}
data.comment: Warning shown when the user moves to another entry or closes the view while an edit is invalid, so the edit is thrown away. {0} = the reason it is invalid, such as "Lexeme Form is required."

data.name: FwAvalonia.EditDiscardedInvalidTitle
data.comment: Title of the warning shown when an invalid edit is thrown away.

data.name: FwAvalonia.AudioRecordingReadOnly
data.value: Audio recording (read-only in the new view)
data.comment: Tooltip on a field in a writing system that holds audio recordings, which the new view can't yet play or record. The recording can still be used in the classic view.

data.name: FwAvalonia.Remove
data.comment: Menu item that removes one item from a field that holds a list of items.

data.name: FwAvalonia.AddItem
data.comment: Placeholder text and screen-reader name of the box and button for adding an item to a field that holds a list of items.

data.name: FwAvalonia.SearchPrompt
data.comment: Placeholder text in a chooser's search box.

data.name: FwAvalonia.AddSelected
data.comment: Button in a chooser that lets the user check several items; adds all the checked items to the field.

data.name: FwAvalonia.CreateOptionPrompt
data.comment: Last row in a chooser's list, which creates a new item from what the user typed. {0} = the typed text, e.g. Create "Sky".

data.name: FwAvalonia.LaunchDialog
data.comment: Screen-reader name of a field's settings button, which opens a dialog for the field.

data.name: FwAvalonia.LauncherUnavailable
data.value: This dialog is not available here.
data.comment: Tooltip on a field's settings button when its dialog can't be opened from this view.

data.name: FwAvalonia.FieldSettings
data.comment: "{0} settings" -- accessible name of a chooser's hover-revealed settings gear.

data.name: FwAvalonia.EditListFormat
data.comment: Link in a list field's chooser that opens the list for editing. {0} = the list's name, e.g. "Edit the Semantic Domains list".

data.name: FwAvalonia.LexemeFormLabel
data.comment: Field label in the lexical entry editor.

data.name: FwAvalonia.MorphTypeLabel
data.comment: Field label in the lexical entry editor.

data.name: FwAvalonia.GlossLabel
data.comment: Field label in the lexical entry editor.

data.name: FwAvalonia.FieldOptionsMenu
data.comment: Screen-reader name and tooltip of the "..." button on each field row, which opens a menu with Field Visibility, Move Field and Help.

data.name: FwAvalonia.CharacterStyle
data.comment: Menu item in a text field's right-click menu; opens the list of the project's character styles to apply to the selected text.

data.name: FwAvalonia.DefaultCharacterStyle
data.comment: The "Default/None" entry that leads the character-style picker; selecting it CLEARS any named character style on the current selection, reverting it to the paragraph's default.

data.name: FwAvalonia.WritingSystem
data.comment: Menu item in a text field's right-click menu; opens the list of the project's writing systems, to change the writing system of the selected text.

data.name: FwAvalonia.Pos.NotSure
data.comment: "<Not sure>" -- the empty Part-of-Speech choice, for when the user hasn't chosen a part of speech.

data.name: FwAvalonia.Pos.Any
data.comment: "<Any>" -- the empty Part-of-Speech choice where leaving it empty means any part of speech (used instead of "<Not sure>").

data.name: FwAvalonia.Pos.CreateNew
data.value: Create a new Part of Speech...
data.comment: Last item in the part-of-speech chooser; opens a dialog to add a new part of speech.

data.name: FwAvalonia.Pos.ChooserName
data.comment: Accessible name of the collapsed Part-of-Speech chooser dropdown.

data.name: FwAvalonia.StText.AddParagraph
data.comment: Screen-reader name and tooltip of the "+" button beside each paragraph in a field that holds several paragraphs; adds a paragraph.

data.name: FwAvalonia.StText.DeleteParagraph
data.comment: Screen-reader name and tooltip of the "×" button beside each paragraph in a field that holds several paragraphs; deletes that paragraph.

data.name: FwAvalonia.StText.ParagraphStyle
data.comment: Button beside each paragraph in a field that holds several paragraphs; opens the list of the project's paragraph styles to apply to that paragraph.

data.name: FwAvalonia.StText.DefaultParagraphStyle
data.comment: The "Default" entry that leads the paragraph-style picker; selecting it CLEARS any named paragraph style on the paragraph, reverting it to the default.

data.name: FwAvalonia.Link
data.comment: Menu item in a text field's right-click menu; adds a link to the selected text, or edits the link already there.

data.name: FwAvalonia.LinkUrlPrompt
data.comment: Placeholder text of the box where the user types the link's address.

data.name: FwAvalonia.LinkApply
data.comment: Button that adds the link, or updates an existing one.

data.name: FwAvalonia.DeleteEmbeddedObject
data.comment: Menu item that deletes the embedded item (such as a link, picture or footnote) at the selection.

data.name: FwAvalonia.Audio.Play
data.comment: Button that plays the field's audio recording.

data.name: FwAvalonia.Audio.Record
data.comment: Button that records audio into the field.

data.name: FwAvalonia.Audio.Clear
data.comment: Button that deletes the field's audio recording.

data.name: FwAvalonia.Audio.RecordUnavailable
data.value: Recording is available on Windows in the new view; use the classic view on this platform.
data.comment: Tooltip on the Record button on platforms where the new view can't record audio.

data.name: FwAvalonia.Audio.NoRecording
data.comment: Shown in an audio field that has no recording yet.

data.name: FwAvalonia.StructuredText.ParagraphName
data.comment: Screen-reader name for one paragraph in a field that holds several paragraphs. {0} = the field label, {1} = the paragraph number, starting at 1.

data.name: FwAvalonia.FeatureGroup.LexicalEntryDialogs
data.comment: Group heading for the entry-editing tools in the catalog.

data.name: FwAvalonia.FeatureGroup.OtherRecordTypes
data.comment: Group heading for the non-entry record-type tools in the catalog.

data.name: FwAvalonia.Feature.LexiconEditPopupDescription
data.value: The popup variant of entry editing.

data.name: FwAvalonia.Chooser.EmptyItemLabel
data.comment: First choice in a list chooser, for leaving the field empty. Translate it the same as "<Empty>" in the classic view's choosers.

data.name: FwAvalonia.Reversal.ShowInReversalIndex
data.comment: The row menu command that jumps to the row's entry in the Reversal Index tool.

data.name: FwAvalonia.Reversal.AddEntryName
data.comment: Screen-reader name for a writing system's empty add row. {0} = the field label, {1} = the writing system abbreviation.
